reviews.text: It’s interesting that this concealor palette has so many different shades that can act as a colour corrector as well. Love many other Wakemake makeup products so decided to try this palette from them.
reviews.zh: 呢盒遮瑕盤有趣嘅係有咁多唔同色號，仲可以當修色用。好鍾意 Wakemake 其他化妝品，所以決定試吓佢哋呢盒。

reviews.text: This little pallet makes me feel like an artist it completely eliminated the uneven colors on my face. This is the second time I’ve bought this pallet and it’s better than the saem one
reviews.zh: 呢盒細細盒用起上嚟好似藝術家咁，完全解決咗我面上嘅膚色不均。已經係第二次買，仲好過 the saem 嗰盒。

reviews.text: Overall, the product works well. It's not full coverage, it is more medium coverage to be worn under other makeup products. The colors included work well with my light skin tone, but I would not recommend for anyone who does not have light to medium skin tone. The texture is more creamy and blends well.
reviews.zh: 整體嚟講，產品表現唔錯。唔係 full coverage，比較似中等遮瑕度，適合配搭其他化妝品用。內附嘅色號配我嘅淺色膚色好夾，但係如果你唔係淺至中等膚色就唔建議買。質地偏 creamy，好容易推開。

reviews.text: Really want to buy 1 multi colour concealer. It is dry after half hour but not really cover my strong Periorbital dark circles unfortunately
reviews.zh: 好想買一盒多色遮瑕。可惜半小時後就變乾，對我嚴重嘅眼周黑眼圈都遮唔到。

reviews.text:
It's very lightweight and blends very smoothly. I do like the color selection being higher than most color correcting palettes and I would like to purchase another when I am finished with this one! 

+Bonus with a brush being added as well!
reviews.zh:
質地好輕，推開好滑。我鍾意佢嘅色號選擇比起大部份修色盤都多，用完之後會想再買一盒！

+另外跟埋支掃，超抵！

reviews.text: I have extremely red and irritated skin and this completely covers it. Anyone with lost of rosacea this is the fix of a lifetime
reviews.zh: 我皮膚又紅又敏感，呢盒完全 cover 得到。任何有玫瑰痤瘡嘅人，呢盒就係你嘅終極救星。

reviews.text: Super handy for redness and dark circles. Creamy but not thick, blends easily. Includes a brush for application. Good coverage for light skin tones—less creamy than The Saem but still covers well.
reviews.zh: 對泛紅同黑眼圈超方便。質地 creamy 但又唔厚，好易推開。跟埋支掃上妝。對淺色肌膚遮瑕度唔錯——比 The Saem 冇咁 creamy，但係遮瑕都仲係幾掂。

reviews.text: I've wanted to try colour correcting and have been looking for one with a few different colours that I can conveniently bring when I travel. I love this palette as it comes in so many colours, although I tend to use only some of them. The texture is slightly creamy so just a tiny dab is sufficient to give good coverage. It even comes with a small brush! I've previously been using "the saem" colour corrector for a few months already, so I find that not all the shades in this palette are useful for me as I don't really do contouring/shading. It is definitely a convenient option to have but I would suggest that it really depends on which shades you would tend to use more freq, you can consider getting this palette.
reviews.zh: 一直想試吓修色產品，搵緊一款有多隻顏色、方便帶去旅行嘅。呢盒我好鍾意，因為色號好齊全，雖然我自己通常淨係用幾隻。質地微微 creamy，輕輕一篤已經夠做到唔錯嘅遮瑕。仲跟埋一支細掃添！我之前用咗 the saem 修色盤幾個月，所以覺得呢盒唔係每隻色號對我都好用，因為我本身唔會 contour／shading。呢盒確實係方便嘅選擇，但我會建議真係睇你會比較常用邊幾隻色，再決定要唔要買。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
